args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields instead of line[0].split(",") to parse the CSV header line so that quoted column names are correctly split and quotes are stripped, preventing row shape mismatches on statements with quoted headers.
args.title: Parse CSV header using splitFields to support quoted column names

args.message: Parse CSV header using splitFields to support quoted column names

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Statements with quoted column names are rejected because the header is split using simple comma separation rather than splitFields, leaving quotes attached to column names and causing shape mismatches.
